summary: Desire and drive flow together in you, so going after what you want feels natural. You've got easy chemistry and the nerve to act on it. Wanting and pursuing live in peace.
body: Desire and drive flow together in you, so going after what you want feels natural. You've got easy chemistry and the nerve to act on it. Wanting and pursuing live in peace. You can want someone and simply tell them, make art and enjoy it, take pleasure without guilt. The only risk in something this smooth is taking the charm for granted, or letting attraction be the only thing you ever chase. Aim the heat at what matters and it fuels a whole life, not just a spark.
gift: At your best: charismatic, alive, at ease with wanting and going after it.
shadow: The trap: taking the easy charm for granted, or only ever chasing the spark.
integration: Let love and values and drive and anger cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Charm plus initiative; manage the push-pull between attraction and aggression.
do: Aim the heat at what actually matters
Let the charm fuel more than the chase
